subject: School Reopening Plan
overview: Medford Public Schools leadership hosted a live Q&A session to address community questions regarding the district's school reopening plan. Administrators reviewed local COVID-19 health metrics and detailed plans for remote learning, hybrid scheduling, facility safety, and special education services.

items.title: Opening Remarks and COVID-19 Metrics
items.summary: District administrators reviewed state COVID-19 positivity data showing Medford in a safe threshold and announced an upcoming HVAC engineering evaluation of Medford High School.

items.title: School Reopening Questions and Answers
items.summary: School leaders answered public questions concerning hybrid and remote learning schedules, special education accommodations, mandatory mask rules, and staff COVID-19 testing.
